sources.label: Morphe patches for DiskWala - Disable ads & Remove forced update screen (24.5)
sources.author: DiskWala
patch_list: Stubs AppLovin, AdMob, InMobi and other ad SDKs at the bytecode level to prevent ads from loading without breaking the app.
Bypasses PairIP license check ('Download from Play Store'), Play Integrity, and signature verification to allow modified and sideloaded app usage.
Neutralizes PairIP traps in native .so libraries and patches Hermes bundle.
Makes RevenueCat entitlements appear active so ads-free and premium features are unlocked.
